heroSub: Bandrol checks on shipment-ready cartons across Mey Diageo plants were automated with a camera-based system.
contextTitle: Central assurance for legal bandrol compliance
contextP1: Bandrol checks on shipment-ready cartons across Mey Diageo plants were automated with a camera-based system.
contextP2: The project ensured that the legally required bandrol is present on every carton.
problemTitle: Risk of shipping cartons with missing bandrol
problemLede: Bandrol presence had to be checked reliably and cartons with missing bandrol had to be prevented from entering shipment flow.

problemList.text: Manual bandrol inspection increased the probability of human error.
Shipping a carton with missing bandrol created legal risk.
Bandrol control had to run automatically and consistently across the line.

solutionTitle: Camera-based automatic control with reject separation
solutionLede: Work order selection automatically sends the relevant camera job; carton serial reading, bandrol presence check, and automatic reject routing are managed in one flow.

steps.title: Work Order and Camera Job Matching
steps.text: The camera job is loaded automatically according to the selected work order.

steps.title: Carton Serial Reading
steps.text: Carton serial numbers are read by barcode scanners as cartons pass the station.

steps.title: Bandrol Presence Check
steps.text: The camera unit performs automatic presence/absence inspection.

steps.title: Automatic Reject Routing
steps.text: Cartons with missing bandrol are diverted to reject line; only compliant cartons continue.

techTitle: Barcode scanners, camera control unit, reject mechanism, PLC

techGrid.title: Barcode Scanners
techGrid.text: Read carton serial numbers and trigger the control data flow.

techGrid.title: Camera Control Unit
techGrid.text: Automatically inspects bandrol presence and returns result signals.

techGrid.title: Reject Mechanism
techGrid.text: Automatically removes cartons with missing bandrol from shipment stream.

techGrid.title: PLC and OnSuite Trace
techGrid.text: Manages field logic and central traceability of inspection outcomes.

integrationTitle: Central process control with SAP and traceability system
integrationDesc: The system is integrated with SAP. Work order is selected in traceability system, camera job is loaded automatically, and serial + inspection results are linked centrally in SAP.

integrationList.text: Camera parameters are loaded automatically based on selected work order.
Carton serial numbers and bandrol inspection outcomes are centrally correlated and reported in SAP.

resultsTitle: Legal compliance, shipment accuracy, process safety

resultsGrid.title: Eliminated Manual Error Risk
resultsGrid.text: Camera-based automation removed manual-inspection-related error risk.

resultsGrid.title: Prevented Missing-Bandrol Shipments
resultsGrid.text: Automatic reject routing prevented non-compliant cartons from reaching shipment.

resultsGrid.title: Central and Secure Flow
resultsGrid.text: Serial reading plus automatic separation improved shipment accuracy and operational safety.
